title: More impact, narrower science?

rows.name: Average annual publication ratio
rows.unit: ratio of average annual papers per researcher
rows.notes: Average yearly papers per researcher in AI-augmented versus non-AI research; observational association. AI-paper classification validation F1=.875; association is not causation.

rows.name: Average annual citation ratio
rows.unit: ratio of average annual citations per researcher
rows.notes: Average yearly citations per researcher in AI-augmented versus non-AI research; observational association. AI-paper classification validation F1=.875; association is not causation.

rows.name: Earlier modelled leadership transition
rows.sourceLocator: Methods: Determine project leader; birth–death model
rows.notes: Modelled transition 7.33 versus 8.70 years; project leadership is proxied by last authorship, not a directly observed promotion or randomized outcome. AI-paper classification validation F1=.875; association is not causation.

rows.name: Lower median knowledge extent
rows.sourceLocator: Methods: Knowledge extent (KE); collective reach comparison
rows.notes: Knowledge extent is maximum distance from the centroid in a 768-dimensional paper-embedding space; 4.63% lower median is not a count of scientific topics. AI-paper classification validation F1=.875; association is not causation.

rows.name: Lower follow-on citation engagement
rows.sourceLocator: Methods: follow-on engagement; collective engagement comparison
rows.notes: Measures how often papers citing a shared focal paper cite one another; 22% lower is not a measurement of personal interaction or collaboration frequency. AI-paper classification validation F1=.875; association is not causation.

denominator: Study-defined AI-augmented and non-AI comparisons across English-language papers in six natural-science disciplines. Annual per-researcher publication/citation ratios, modelled career transition, embedding-space knowledge extent and citation-network engagement have different denominators and cannot be added.

reuse.notes: No open-data licence is asserted. Only a small, separately structured factual summary is included; full-source republication is outside this pack.

coverage.population: English-language papers in six natural-science disciplines, 1980–2025; bibliometric corpus without national allocation
coverage.included: 5 populated records; inclusion is defined by the exact source locator in every row
coverage.omitted: No national ranking, field-level citation network, underlying paper records or causal intervention
coverage.missingness: Unobserved or unpublished is not zero; omitted places/classes have no inferred values.

uncertainty: Observational bibliometrics with selection and field confounding. AI-paper classification validation F1=.875 is imperfect. Last authorship is a leadership proxy; transition time is modelled. Knowledge extent depends on the chosen embedding representation. No causal claim, social-contact measure, common score or future extrapolation is supported.

transform.description: Transcribed selected published factual findings into a normalized long table; values retain source precision. No interpolation or score normalization.
transform.validation: Row-level source locators; numerical bounds and schema checked locally; independent review pending.

verification.method: Primary publication/table read and values transcribed, with comparison to source metadata; independent acceptance pending.

scoring.reason: No defensible common 1–100 extremity construct. Display source metric and uncertainty in original units.

forecast.reason: No original future extrapolation; any model evaluations are retrospective results only.
